answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and let reputation accrue only through completed, paid work. A jetty that admits only staked boats keeps the harbor honest: a Sybil operator must fund each fake identity, and a pearl of earned history cannot be copied to a fresh account. Put the stake on a mesa of public, slashable collateral — misbehavior burns it — so creating a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand stakes while honest agents keep trading.
